summary: Pacira BioSciences filed an 8-K on June 28, 2026, announcing a Stock and Asset Purchase Agreement to divest its wholly owned subsidiary Pacira CryoTech and related assets (iovera handheld cryoanalgesia devices) to Zimmer, Inc., a Zimmer Biomet subsidiary. Consideration is up to $140.0M, comprising $70.0M upfront (subject to customary adjustments) plus up to $70.0M in contingent earnouts based on revenue milestones through 2031. Approximately 66 employees (~8% of workforce) are expected to be hired by the buyer. Closing, expected in Q3 2026, is subject to customary conditions. Watch for antitrust clearance and potential competing bids.
